items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'The Midnight Visitor', and answer.

"The man by the window raised his gun. 'The papers, please.' The old detective did not move. 'Of course,' he said mildly. 'But I should warn you – the guard downstairs checks this room every ten minutes, and he is due right about … now.' Footsteps sounded on the stairs. The gunman glanced at the door, and in that second the detective switched off the lamp."
